caption: A vibrant, spicy ramen broth glows beneath a generous mound of shredded cabbage and chopped green onions. Served in a white bowl with red trim, it rests on a warm, orange-toned surface under soft, ambient lighting.

segments_info.text: The table is a smooth, vibrant orange surface with subtle light reflections and faint texture variations.
Chashu pork slice shows caramelized, glossy brown exterior with tender, layered texture and slight fat marbling.
The spicy broth is vibrant red, glossy, and thick, swirling around noodles and toppings with visible oil sheen and floating green onions.
White ceramic bowl with red rim, smooth surface, slightly glossy finish, and faint speckles visible.
